{{Infobox auto}}

'''Wheat grain''' is the seed of wheat and the base of [[flour]]. It replaces {{MCW|Wheat Seeds|wheat seeds}}: planting it grows wheat, and 3 grain grind into 1 flour.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/recipe/food/crafting/flour.json}}</ref> In the early game it is found by breaking grass with a hoe.

== Obtaining ==

=== Breaking grass ===
Short grass broken with a hoe has a 1 in 8 chance to drop wheat grain, increased by Fortune; otherwise it drops itself. Without a hoe or shears it drops nothing.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/minecraft/loot_table/blocks/short_grass.json}}</ref>

=== Farming ===
A fully grown wheat crop drops 1 [[straw]] and 0 to 3 grain, with more from Fortune or the Electrum tool intrinsic. An unripe crop drops 1 grain.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/minecraft/loot_table/blocks/wheat.json}}</ref>

{{Sources}}

== Usage ==

Picking up wheat grain unlocks the [[flour]] recipe. Two grain also go into [[Apple Cinnamon Oatmeal|apple cinnamon oatmeal]]. Wheat grain can be planted and fed to chickens as in vanilla.
